title: Show HN: I made a Clojure-like language in Go, boots in 7ms
summary: A Clojure-like language (~90% JVM Clojure compatible) implemented entirely in pure Go, featuring a ~10MB static binary with a cold boot time of just 7ms - approximately 50x faster than JVM Clojure and 3x faster than Babashka. The project delivers competitive throughput on algorithmic workloads comparable to GraalVM-backed sci.
problem_solved: Eliminates JVM startup latency for Clojure scripts by providing a lightweight Go-based runtime with near-instant boot times.
why_valuable: Enables Clojure developers to write scripts and CLIs with instant startup without sacrificing language familiarity or rewriting existing code.
